text:
Nadia V.: Quick: I'm assembling a minimal migration checklist + micro-examples for Dedicated Capacity. Goal: readable quickstart for engineers who just want a working reserved pool + explicit notes for autoscale and isolation. Drafting now.
Liam H.: Great. Can we include a Go snippet? A lot of infra folks use Go SDK. Also please make the quota check super visible.
Ravi S.: Please avoid hard SLA claims in the quickstart. Link to SLA page instead. We shouldn't publish percentile numbers in a how-to.
docs-bot: link-check: broken link detected: /handbook/dedicated/rlos -> 404. Referenced by handbook/dedicated/quickstart.md.
Nadia V.: Thanks, I'll point SLA links to /handbook/dedicated/sla-and-slos and add a TODO for anchors after we fix redirects. Also will update handbook links list.
eng-runtime: FYI the runtime default autoscale cooldown is 300s; include it explicitly in examples and note preemption interactions (see runtime ticket #451).
QA-bot: checklist-scan: recommend adding a smoke-test step post-provision that verifies model inference latency under a load of 50rps for 2 mins.
Nadia V.: Adding smoke-test. Draft terraform snippet (keep variable names consistent):
```terraform
resource "redwood_dedicated_capacity" "prod_pool" {
  name                     = "prod-reserved"
  gpu_type                 = "a100"
  reserved_pool_replicas   = 3
  scale_policy             = "autoscale"
  isolation                = "reserved-pool"
}
```
Nadia V.: Draft Python snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
client.create_dedicated_capacity(
  name="prod-reserved",
  gpu_type="a100",
  replicas=3,
  scale_policy={'type':'autoscale','cooldown_seconds':300},
  isolation='reserved-pool'
)
```
Liam H.: Go snippet please (simple example):
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
policy := redwood.ScalePolicy{Type: "autoscale", CooldownSeconds: 300}
client.CreateDedicatedCapacity(redwood.DedicatedCapacity{
  Name: "prod-reserved",
  GPUType: "a100",
  Replicas: 3,
  ScalePolicy: policy,
  Isolation: "reserved-pool",
})
```
Ravi S.: For the Deep Dive link, include a short paragraph on eviction semantics: reserved-pool -> stronger isolation, tenant -> shared with chance of preemption. Keep it factual and link to operational doc.
Nadia V.: Will open a draft PR and tag #eng-runtime, #docs-review, and #qa. I'll add a short migration checklist at the top: (1) export routing config, (2) provision in staging, (3) smoke test 50rps for 2 mins, (4) rotate automation keys, (5) lift traffic by 10% increments with 30m waits, (6) monitor for 24h.
docs-bot: PR created (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9955 (Nadia V.)
Liam H.: I'll review snippets and sanity-check var names.
eng-runtime: I'll verify the preemption note before you merge.
Nadia V.: Thanks all, will ping reviewers when ready.
